flowchart TD
    START["Start PR Process"] --> SUBMIT["Submit Pull Request"]
    SUBMIT --> LINT_CHECK{"Passes Linting?"}
    LINT_CHECK -- "No" --> FIX_LINT["Fix pylint/flake8 issues"]
    FIX_LINT --> SUBMIT
    LINT_CHECK -- "Yes" --> COV_CHECK{"Coverage >= 80%?"}
    COV_CHECK -- "No" --> ADD_TESTS["Increase Test Coverage"]
    ADD_TESTS --> SUBMIT
    COV_CHECK -- "Yes" --> REVIEW{"Maintainer Review"}
    REVIEW -- "Changes Requested" --> FIX_CODE["Address Review Comments"]
    FIX_CODE --> SUBMIT
    REVIEW -- "Approved" --> MERGE["Merge to Main"]
    MERGE --> END["End"]
    %% Mapping to identifiers
    LINT_CHECK -.-> RULE-LINT["RULE-LINT"]
    COV_CHECK -.-> GATE-COVERAGE["GATE-COVERAGE"]
    REVIEW -.-> WF-PR-REVIEW["WF-PR-REVIEW"]
